39:57.text: he should say: "If only Allâh had guided me, I should indeed have been among the Muttaqûn

39:58.text: he should say when he sees the torment: "If only I had another chance
, then I should indeed be among the Muhsinûn

39:59.text: Yes! Verily, there came to you My Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
and you denied them, and were proud

39:60.text: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied against Allâh
- their faces will be black. Is there not in Hell an abode for the arrogant?

39:61.text: And Allâh will deliver those who are the Muttaqûn
. Evil shall touch them not, nor shall they grieve.

39:62.text: Allâh is the Creator of all things, and He is the Wakîl

39:63.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And those who disbelieve in the Ayât
of Allâh, such are they who will be the losers.

39:64.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to the polytheists)
: "Do you order me to worship other than Allâh? O you fools!"

39:65.text: And indeed it has been revealed to you
before you: "If you join others in worship with Allâh,
your deeds will be in vain, and you will certainly be among the losers."

39:67.text: They made not a just estimate of Allâh such as is due to Him. And on the Day of Resurrection the whole of the earth will be grasped by His Hand
and the heavens will be rolled up in His Right Hand.Glorified be He, and High be He above all that they associate as partners with Him!
